title: Term indicator under binary sign encoding
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates. Under the coordinatewise bijection from binary vectors to sign vectors, the indicator of the event that $T$ evaluates to $-1$ equals the indicator of the affine subspace consisting of the satisfying binary base point of $T$ plus the subspace of vectors that vanish on the support of $T$.
